text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

Fired up to prove she could grow even 
further in a race without Narita Brian, 
Mayano Top Gun headed onto the track.

Hishi Amazon brought Narita Brian to the 
racetrack so she could see Mayano Top Gun 
run with her own eyes.

Narita Brian kept a watchful eye on Mayano 
Top Gun from afar. As she watched... the 
Takarazuka Kinen was about to begin.
